name: racktrack-sweep-native
description: RackTrack Sweep as an iOS and Android app: a Capacitor shell that connects to a RackTrack server and opens its app.

scripts.android:debug: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:sim: npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath ios/build build
